eligibility.rule: An all-features model is a selection candidate only if (1) the train shortcut audit flags no content feature, (2) it beats the behavior-only model of the same family in every chronological train fold, and (3) it beats the content-only model of the same family in every train fold. Otherwise behavior-only selection stands. Validation is not used for these checks.

novelty.statement: Zero outbound mail raises the relationship component only when the sender has other outbound history. A cold sender scores 0 on that component. The component is one of three, so novelty does not set the whole score.

novelty.note: Coefficients share collinear count features and are not separate effects.
